content.text: 0 seconds of 1 minute, 50 secondsVolume 0% Young completes comeback to win 2026 Players March 15, 2026 06:52 PM In this edition of the Golf Channel Podcast with Rex & Lav, the guys, live from TPC Sawgrass, discuss all of the storylines heading into the final round of The Players Championship, including Ludvig Åberg's chances of closing out the biggest win of his career. Cameron Young won The Players Championship and with it, a massive pay day.Young finished one shot clear of Matt Fitzpatrick on Sunday at TPC Sawgrass. It was Young’s second career PGA Tour title (2025 Wyndham Championship) and came with a $4.5 million check.Fitzpatrick, who bogeyed the final hole, earned $2,225,000.
